comment: Weathers and 'sports' (Climate.cs), cast by moves of family 'climate' (realtime_moves.json). A weather covers the whole arena for 'duration' seconds, for both teams; one at a time, the last one cast replaces the other. terrains: traces of that terrain are bigger (radiusMul) and last longer (durationMul), the ones already on the ground included (their remaining time is scaled when the weather starts); typeDamage: damage of moves of that type; chip: share of max HP lost every second by every Pokémon but immuneTypes; scatter: now and then (chance per second) a small trace of that terrain appears on a random free tile; tint / alpha: colour laid over the screen; shots: speed and range multiplier of the shots of a type; wind (storms): a direction drawn at the start, a shot with it gains up to 'strength' of its speed and range and loses as much against it, 'sensitive' types feel it more, 'heavyTypes' not at all; scroll: tiles/s its pattern (weather_<key> in Resources/Effects) drifts, with the wind or straight down; weather_icon_<key>: its icon on screen. A sport is a zone around its caster (look: sport_<key>, stretched over it) (radius, duration): the terrains it lists are wiped out inside and cannot be laid there, and moves of the typeDamage types hurt less the Pokémon inside it.
